[EN] Oh Brothers, Where Art Thou?
[ES] Oh hermanos, ¿dónde están?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please find my b-brothers!
[ES] ¡Por favor, encuentra a mis h-hermanos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We can't return until the b-beasts b-behave.
[ES] No podemos regresar hasta que las b-bestias se p-porten bien.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I never doubted you."
[ES] "Nunca dudé de ti."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Jurik and Rabak in the far southwest reaches of Seeliewood.
[ES] Encuentra a Jurik y Rabak en los confines del suroeste de Seeliewood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
